grammarFocus: 现在完成时入门；already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分。
title: A New Skill at the Community Center
instructions: 这是一份模拟听力练习，适合B1水平成人学习者。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答10个问题。问题类型包括单选、填空和判断正误/未提及。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文，并附有原文证据。
transcript:
Woman: Hi, Tom. I haven't seen you at the community center for a while. Where have you been?
Man: Oh, hi, Lisa. I've been really busy. I started a new evening class three weeks ago.
Woman: Really? What class is it?
Man: It's a cooking class. I've always wanted to learn how to cook properly. I've already learned how to make three dishes.
Woman: That's great! Have you finished the course yet?
Man: No, not yet. It's a twelve-week course. I've been going since the beginning of March.
Woman: So you've been in the class for about three weeks?
Man: Yes, that's right. I've really enjoyed it so far. The teacher is very patient.
Woman: Have you made any friends there?
Man: Yes, I've met a few people. There's a woman named Maria. She's been cooking for years, but she says she's still learning new things.
Woman: That's interesting. I've never taken a cooking class. I've always cooked at home, but I just follow simple recipes.
Man: You should join! The next course starts in June. Have you decided what to do yet?
Woman: Not yet. I've been thinking about it, but I'm not sure I have time.
Man: Well, the classes are only once a week, on Tuesday evenings. I've found it very relaxing.
Woman: Maybe I'll try it. I've heard good things about that teacher.
Man: Yes, she's excellent. Oh, I have to go now. I've got a lot of homework for the class!
Woman: OK, see you later. Let me know how it goes!

questions.explanation: Tom明确说‘It's a cooking class.’，所以答案是烹饪课。

questions.prompt: How long has Tom been going to the class?
questions.explanation: Tom说‘I've been going since the beginning of March.’，而Lisa问‘So you've been in the class for about three weeks?’ Tom回答‘Yes, that's right.’，所以是大约三周。
questions.evidence: So you've been in the class for about three weeks? Yes, that's right.

questions.prompt: Has Tom finished the course yet?
questions.explanation: Lisa问‘Have you finished the course yet?’ Tom回答‘No, not yet.’，说明他还没完成课程。
questions.evidence: Have you finished the course yet? No, not yet.

questions.prompt: Tom has already learned how to make ______ dishes. (Use one word from the transcript.)
questions.explanation: Tom说‘I've already learned how to make three dishes.’，所以填three。
questions.evidence: I've already learned how to make three dishes.

questions.prompt: What does Tom say about Maria?
options: She has been cooking for years.
She started the class last week.
answers: She has been cooking for years.
questions.explanation: Tom说‘She's been cooking for years’，所以Maria已经做饭多年。

questions.prompt: Has Lisa ever taken a cooking class?
questions.explanation: Lisa说‘I've never taken a cooking class.’，所以她没有上过烹饪课。
questions.evidence: I've never taken a cooking class.

questions.prompt: When does the next course start?
questions.explanation: Tom说‘The next course starts in June.’，所以下一期课程在六月开始。
questions.evidence: The next course starts in June.

questions.explanation: Tom说‘the classes are only once a week’，所以课程每周一次。
questions.evidence: the classes are only once a week

questions.prompt: Tom says the class is on Tuesday evenings.
questions.explanation: Tom明确说‘on Tuesday evenings’，所以该陈述为真。

questions.prompt: Lisa has decided to join the cooking class.
questions.explanation: Lisa说‘Not yet. I've been thinking about it, but I'm not sure I have time.’，说明她还没决定，所以‘已经决定加入’是错误的。
questions.evidence: Not yet. I've been thinking about it, but I'm not sure I have time.

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for；与一般过去时区分
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响或结果，或从过去开始持续到现在的状态。结构为 have/has + 过去分词。already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还未”或“已经”；since 后接时间点，for 后接时间段。一般过去时只表示过去发生的动作，与现在无关。例如：I have already learned...（强调现在会了）；I started...（只说明过去开始）。
grammar.example: I've already learned how to make three dishes.

questions.explanation: already 常与现在完成时连用，表示“已经完成”，结构为 has + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: I've already learned how to make three dishes.

questions.explanation: yet 用于疑问句，现在完成时结构 have + 过去分词，eat 的过去分词是 eaten。
questions.evidence: Have you finished the course yet?

questions.explanation: since 后接时间点（2010），表示从那时持续到现在。
questions.evidence: I've been going since the beginning of March.

questions.prompt: He has worked in this company ______ five years.
questions.explanation: for 后接时间段（five years），表示持续了五年。
questions.evidence: I've been in the class for about three weeks?
